cases.name: momentum-synthetic-dated-divergence
cases.reading: Harbor's measured rebounding is strong while coverage leans cautious, and rating notability increased by eight points over a two-observation window while coverage tone decreased by twelve points. These distinct metrics describe separate aspects of the current picture; neither establishes that the other is wrong or explains a change over time.
review: Explain the dated change in statistical distinctiveness without calling it skill improvement.
Preserve two-observation sample and different coverage/performance dimensions; missing peer is unknown.
